Lesson 10.1 · 35 of 78 · 22 min · Verified 17 Jul 2026

Product architecture, schemes and policy versions

After this lesson you can:
  • Separate product, scheme, programme and policy version
  • Define effective dating and in-flight treatment
  • Write rollback-safe product requirements

Learning rhythm: read one section at a time, pause to explain the control in your own words, then answer the knowledge check without looking back.

On this page
  1. Four objects that should not collapse
  2. Effective dating and the in-flight book
  3. Acceptance cases
  4. Regulatory anchors
  5. Where this lives in LoanOS
  6. Knowledge check

1. Four objects that should not collapse

A product family describes the economic form — term loan, revolving facility, invoice finance.

A programme binds the participating RE, channel and commercial arrangement.

A scheme narrows segment, geography or campaign.

A policy version owns executable eligibility, pricing and authority rules.

Treating these as one configuration blob makes audit, reuse and change impact impossible.

The application stores references to the versions it actually used. Later edits must not silently rewrite an earlier decision.

2. Effective dating and the in-flight book

Every publication needs draft, review, approval, effective-from and retirement states.

The BA must specify which milestone freezes each term: lead creation, application submission, decision, sanction or disbursement.

A rate change may apply to new applications while a compliance correction may require controlled migration.

The safe default is no implicit migration. Impact analysis identifies affected applications and a maker-checker action records any re-price, re-decision or grandfathering.

3. Acceptance cases

Cover future-dated activation, overlapping versions, expired sanctions, rollback after applications exist, and a replay using the original bundle. A product screen is incomplete until the same rules are proven at API and decision-engine boundaries.

Regulatory anchors

  • RBI-IT-GRC — Governed change, traceability and controlled processing apply to product configuration.
  • RBI-KFS-2024 — The active product and price must resolve to the terms disclosed in the KFS.

Family IDs resolve in the India regulatory register (docs/compliance/india-regulatory-register.md), which owns sources and caveats.

Knowledge check

Answer aloud or write your choice before opening the explanation. If you miss it, revisit the named section—not the whole lesson.

1. A policy is edited after an application was approved. What should replay use?

  1. The newest policy
  2. The exact version referenced by the original decision
  3. A manually reconstructed rule
  4. Whichever produces the same answer
Reveal answer and reasoning

B. Replay and lineage require the exact effective policy used at decision time.
